title: Compositional Online Learning for Semantic Data Processing Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.27244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An LLM call in a semantic data processing system is expensive enough to dominate query cost, yet slow enough to hide a CPU-side learner's update behind its round-trip. In production, LLM compute accounts for $80-90\%$ of query cost, and each call costs $10^5-10^7\times$ a relational predicate. The latency window inverts a design constraint of classical adaptive query processing, where online learners had to stay lightweight to avoid dominating the predicates they optimize. At LLM latency, per-call gradient steps and per-batch threshold solves fit inside the round-trip. We develop compositional online learning at the LLM call boundary: a framework for combining online-learning components in semantic data processing systems. Each component makes execution-time decisions and refines its learned artifacts online. translated_title: 语义数据处理系统的组合式在线学习
translated_abstract: 在语义数据处理系统中，一次LLM调用的成本高到足以主导查询开销，但其延迟又足够慢，以至于CPU端学习器的更新可以隐藏在其往返时间之后。在生产环境中，LLM计算占查询成本的80-90%，每次调用的成本是关系谓词的10^5-10^7倍。这种延迟窗口颠覆了经典自适应查询处理的设计约束，其中在线学习器必须保持轻量级，以避免主导它们所优化的谓词。在LLM延迟下，每次调用的梯度步骤和每批次的阈值求解可以适应在往返时间内完成。我们在LLM调用边界上开发了组合式在线学习：一个用于在语义数据处理系统中组合在线学习组件的框架。每个组件在执行时做出决策，并在线精炼其学习到的工件。设计空间跨越两个维度：决策粒度和学习器更新节奏，组件共享单一学习模式。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在LLM调用边界上的组合式在线学习框架，利用LLM调用的高延迟窗口来执行轻量级学习更新，从而优化语义数据处理系统的查询性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a compositional online learning framework at the LLM call boundary, leveraging the high latency window of LLM calls to perform lightweight learning updates, thereby optimizing query performance in semantic data processing systems.
